mechanism: Pioglitazone may increase haloperidol levels through CYP3A4 inhibition, and both drugs can cause metabolic effects including weight gain and glucose dysregulation; haloperidol may worsen hyperglycemia control in diabetic patients.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, assess for signs of haloperidol toxicity (extrapyramidal effects, tardive dyskinesia), and consider haloperidol dose reduction if necessary; ensure regular metabolic monitoring.
